tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal dpal mgon zhal la bcol gdams gnyer gtad kyi yi ge dam tshig rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs so// swasti/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las drag po'i sku/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i mthu bo che/ /nyes legs dam tshig rjes gcod bya ra ba/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po yum bzhi 'khor bcas dgongs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum he ru ka /rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan/ /gzugs gzhan zlos pa bsod nams seng ge yis/ /tshad ma'i spyi don rtsom par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sgrib med 'od gsal dag pa'i snang ba la/ /kun mkhyen nyid dang bla ma lho rin pas/ /mi rtog ma la bstod dbyangs gyer ba'i skabs/ /lung pa'i phu nas dmag tshogs rol mor bcas/ /zhal bzhi'i dpung chen yin zhes byon pa'i tshe/ /nag po khyod nyid sku tshad ches mtho ba'i/ /zhabs pus man la'ang thog tshad gsum gyi dpangs/ /'khor rnams go cha'i 'od zer lhag se lhag /rb+pa gyi sna 'bur khrom khrom dang bcas pas/ /khyod kyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi/ /bdag po nga zhes mdongs gsol khas blangs ltar/ /deng sang bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la babs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyi/ /don gyi 'gal 'grel dpyod la tshad ma zhes/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan chos grags sogs/ /paṇa grub du ma'i bzhed srol gangs ljongs 'dir/ /dar zhing rgyas mod phal cher cha shas tsam/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇḍi ta/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i bzhed gzhung rma med pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i dge mtshan de/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur spel ba la/ /kun mkhyen bla ma bsod nams seng ge de/ /sa skya paṇa chen slar yang 'byon ltar gyur/ /gang gi bzhed gzhung dri med 'dzin pa'i sde/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal du/ /mkhas grub du mas tha snyad sde snod dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa spel ba yi/

/rgyun bzang deng sang nub la nye dus 'dir/ /dpal mgon khyod kyis mthu stobs dpung bskyed la/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' sgrub dus la babs/ /chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi/ /mkhan slob dge 'dun sde dang sbyin bdag dang / /longs spyod dpal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun/ /zhi drag thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ /lung rtogs yon tan tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor snyan grags legs tshogs yon tan kun/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur cher rgyas nas/ /chos dang srid kyi dge legs dar bar mdzod/ /khams gsum snod bcud longs spyod thams cad dang / /khyad par mkhas grub rgyal blon stobs 'byor can/ /dregs pa'i 'gro ba mi dang mi min kun/ /ma lus dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /log par lta ba'i dgra 'dre byur gsum dang / /sdang zhing mtho 'tshams zhi bas mi thul ba/ /dgon gnas 'di la log par lta ba rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs myur du tshar gcod mdzod/ /khyad par chos rje khu dbon bzhed srol mchog /pod chen drug dang grags chen bco brgyad la/ /thos bsam sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i shes ldan tshogs/ /shes rab rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ltar mdzod/ /de la brten nas lung dang rig pa yi/ /spobs pa dge ba rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen ltar gyur nas/ /rgol ba ngan pa mtha' dag zil gnon cing / /rnam par dag pa'i lung dang rig pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la byi dor rgya cher mdzod/ /mdor na chos skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po khyed/ /nus mthur ldan zhing dam tshig bsrung ba la/ /bstan srung gzhan las khyad par 'phags so zhes/ /'phags bod paṇa grub kun gyis bsngags pa bzhin/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed dus la babs/ /de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rgyal ba bsod nams seng ge'i thugs bskyed dang /

/bstan srung dbang po khyed kyi mthu rtsal gyis/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don kun lhun 'grub shog /ces chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal du rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung bzang 'jam mgon bla ma sa skya paṇḍi tas legs par bkral ba'i bzhed srol kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ges dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa 'di nyid/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir je zhan du song dogs 'dug ces chos grwa chen po de nyid kyi gdan sa nyer dgu pa mkhan rin po che ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan nas dngos su gsung sgros mdzad pa dang chabs cig de la phan pa'i thabs ji 'dra dgos gsung dus nged rang gis lhan skyes la dpal mgon zhal la 'phrin 'chol mdzad na legs 'dra snyam pa shar don bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dgon de'i chos bdag mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la thugs dam gnad bskul zhus pa'i dge ba des/ chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal du da dung mkhas grub kyi skyes bu zam ma chad par byon nas dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde sangs rgyas mos pa'i 'dus pa rnams la 'gran bzod ltar gyur te/ de rnams kyang lung rig smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed srol kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ges dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rgyun 'di srid mtha'i bar du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ thub bstan rnam rgyal dpal mgon zhal la bcol gdams gnyer gtad kyi yi ge / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
